reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators define a structured progression through survey, investigation, and synthesis phases. The survey completion status (S) acts as a global predicate that gates further operations. The git merge sequence (M) encodes the topological structure of code evolution, where each node represents a commit and edges represent merge actions. Quarantine holds (Q) introduce a failure mode where dependencies are unresolved, blocking further progress. Deployment readiness (R) synthesizes these into a probabilistic readiness score based on task completion and system health. These form a layered causal network where S → M → R, with Q acting as a dynamic constraint on M. The failure modes arise from unmodeled dependencies or incomplete task lists, which can be detected via telemetry of task completion flags and merge conflicts.
